A published catalogue, for example the book that accompanies an exhibition.

Title of the artwork, exhibition or catalogue.
Person who made the artwork.
Date the artwork was created.
Date of creation exactly as given in the source, for example 1972-73 or 1970s.
Object type exactly as given in the source, for example Super-8 film loop (originally 16 mm).
Materials and technique exactly as given in the source, for example Ink-jet on canvas; hand lettering and acrylic paint.

Material or materials used to make the artwork.

Identifier in the Getty Art & Architecture Thesaurus.
Date the exhibition opened.
Date the exhibition closed.
Number of the item in the exhibition catalogue. Qualifier of 'Exhibited at'.
Page(s) of the exhibition catalogue on which the item is listed or reproduced. Qualifier of 'Exhibited at'.
Title under which the artwork was shown, if different from its current title. Qualifier of 'Exhibited at'.
Free-text note. Qualifier of 'Exhibited at' and 'Appears in catalogue'.
Subtitle of the catalogue as printed.
Person who wrote texts in the catalogue.
Publishing house or institution that published the catalogue.
Year or date when the catalogue was published.
13-digit International Standard Book Number.
Identifier (IDN) of the catalogue record in the German National Library.
Web page that describes the catalogue, for example its record in the German National Library.
Exhibition that the catalogue documents. Inverse of 'Exhibition catalogue'.
Catalogue that documents the exhibition. Inverse of 'Catalogue of'.
Catalogue in which the artwork appears
datatype: for example the catalogue the record was taken from. Optional qualifiers give the scan page and region so that the extraction can be reviewed.

description_en: Sequence number of the scanned page (first scan page = 1) on which the artwork was found. Not the printed page number. Qualifier of 'Appears in catalogue'.
Rectangle on the scanned page where the entry is, as a W3C Media Fragment, for example xywh=percent:10,20,40,8 (x, y, width, height in percent of the page). Qualifier of 'Appears in catalogue'.
How the entry was found, for example 'plan-c qwen3-vl:8b', 'plan-b hocr' or 'manual'. Qualifier of 'Appears in catalogue'.
Result of the manual check: unreviewed; confirmed; corrected or rejected. Qualifier of 'Appears in catalogue'.
